title: Find the display names of users who posted at least one comment containing
question: Find the display names of users who posted at least one comment containing a website URL and also own at least one post that received a bounty of 50 in 2011. Among these users, return first three whose number of posts is more than twice the number of votes they cast.

prediction.sql:
WITH url_comment_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_010 AS uid
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.XCL_008 LIKE '%http%'
),
bounty_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.XCL_033 AS uid
    FROM posts p
    JOIN votes v ON v.XCL_067 = p.XCL_026
    WHERE v.XCL_071 = 50
      AND strftime('%Y', v.XCL_069) = '2011'
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052 AS uid, u.XCL_055 AS name
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT uid FROM url_comment_users)
      AND u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT uid FROM bounty_users)
),
stats AS (
    SELECT
        q.uid,
        q.name,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE p.XCL_033 = q.uid) AS post_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v WHERE v.XCL_070 = q.uid) AS vote_count
    FROM qualifying q
)
SELECT name
FROM stats
WHERE post_count > 2 * vote_count
ORDER BY uid
LIMIT 3

)
SELECT name
FROM stats

ORDER BY uid

      AND strftime('%Y', v.XCL_069) = '2011'
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052 AS uid, u.XCL_055 AS name
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT uid FROM url_comment_users)
      AND u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT uid FROM bounty_users)
),
stats AS (
    SELECT
        q.uid,
        q.name,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE p.XCL_033 = q.uid) AS post_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v WHERE v.XCL_070 = q.uid) AS vote_count
    FROM qualifying q
)
SELECT name
FROM stats
WHERE post_count > 2 * vote_count
ORDER BY uid
LIMIT 3
